hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && git ls-files --error-unmatch "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && git add "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in plans/README|*/plans/README|plans/ASSUMPTIONS|*/plans/ASSUMPTIONS) ;; plans/*|*/plans/*) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && flatpak run --command=python3 de.tum.in.isabelle.Isabelle tools/gen_assumptions.py ;; esac; }
